newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy economy going better than forecast - Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Italy economy going better than forecast - Prodi.

text.p: Prime Minister Romani Prodi said on Friday that Italy's economy was performing better than forecasts had envisaged and with no sign of a drop in consumption.
He made his comments at an end of year news conference without giving figures.
"The economy is recovery much better than forecast," Prodi said. Despite talk of falling consumption, "I look at the figures every day and they are not falling.
"Consumption is growing very slightly, I have to give it a bit of a push, but it is not falling," he said.
